description: This file defines classes and types for managing WebSocket connections within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations for ConnectionMetaData and WebSocketEndPoint, which handle WebSocket connection metadata and endpoint operations respectively, utilizing the websocketpp library.

classes.name: ConnectionMetaData
classes.description: Represents metadata for a WebSocket connection, including connection handle, status, messages, and synchronization semaphore.

classes.name: WebSocketEndPoint
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client endpoint, including connection management, message sending, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection metadata with ID, handle, and URI.

methods.name: ~ConnectionMetaData
methods.description: Destructor for ConnectionMetaData.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Handler invoked when WebSocket connection opens.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Handler invoked when WebSocket connection fails.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handler invoked when WebSocket connection closes.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handler invoked when a message is received.

methods.name: getHandle
methods.description: Returns the connection handle.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the connection identifier.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the connection.

methods.name: getLastMessage
methods.description: Returns the last message received.

methods.name: getErrorReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for an error, if any.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URI associated with the connection.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Blocks until an event occurs on the connection.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint
methods.description: Constructor for WebSocket endpoint managing multiple connections.

methods.name: ~WebSocketEndPoint
methods.description: Destructor for WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified URI.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over a WebSocket connection and retrieves the response.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection with the given ID and status code.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific connection by ID.
